ShrubSign 3.3.0 adds an in-app install sheet, clearer progress through 100% when installation is confirmed, a more compact iPad layout, and improved Fully Local setup and recovery.

### Installation

- Open the install page inside ShrubSign. After you approve the iOS prompt and the download starts, the sheet closes and the installer shows progress. Open in Safari is available if the prompt does not appear in the sheet.
- See packaging, transfer, and iOS installation as separate phases. Confirmed installs show **Installed** and **100%**. When iOS gives ShrubSign too little information to verify completion, the installer shows **Install unconfirmed**.
- Fully Local loads the current trust identity for each attempt and checks that the install manifest points to the expected signed app, build, and local download. Automatic tries Semi Local first and can use trusted Fully Local when the online helper fails.
- Retry with a fresh link, try a different mode for a single attempt, or copy the error details. The installer fits its contents on supported iPadOS versions and scrolls when more room is needed.

### Signing and library

- Quick Sign & Install opens the exact app it just signed. Bulk installation runs in order and lets you retry or skip an app with an issue.
- IPA imports show errors, concurrent downloads with the same filename get distinct destinations, and malformed tweak archives produce an error instead of crashing.
